content:
If you want to launch on vibe/vibe testnet:

1. Read <#1541735497527853148>
2. Get testnet funds from <#1541738768468414484> if needed.
3. Make sure to check <#1541735529048051762> to see if you find anything useful for you.
4. Launch by creating a bonding curve on vibevibe testnet.
6. Share your launched project in <#1544666579898339328>.
7. Use <#1544666860744744990> if you get stuck.
